device.type: Single-tuner DVB-S2 HD satellite PVR receiver
device.soc: ALi M3511 / M3503 (bootloader version "M3503---0.1.0"; 128 MB DDR3 with the SEE partition at 96..128 MB, 0x86000200)
device.family: M3503 (chips/m3503.py: 128 MB DDR3 M3503 with XIP cache-as-RAM bootloader and CryptoEngine SHA-256)

source.author: Opticum / Globo
source.note: Archive Opticum XS65_140_M3511-RETAIL_PL.zip from the Opticum directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-07.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB DDR3 M3503 board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_xs65_m3511_app_starts.py): runs XIP with its stack in cache-as-RAM (0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF), switches to RAM at 0x81016BCC, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1016804, unpacks seecode ("00000140") to 0x86000200 and maincode ("112003000202162") to 0x80000200, starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001), and renders its OSD through the graphics engine (241 GE commands).

desc: Opticum XS65 Polish retail firmware 1.4.0 (140_M3511-RETAIL_PL.abs, 2016-04-13) for the single-tuner DVB-S2 HD satellite receiver on the 128 MB ALi M3511 / M3503 platform with 4 MB SPI flash.

Unlike the 8 MB / 256 MB XS65 Twin and XS65 Combo builds, this 4 MB single-tuner build runs in 128 MB DDR3 without upper-DDR remapping, placing its SEE co-processor image at 0x86000200 (EBase 0x86002001).
